first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the source record because discounts can reduce margins or attract lower-retention customers; proceed only as a guarded segment-level test while assessing qualified revenue, retention, and payback.

final.rationale: Reject promotional pricing because the verified cohort gained qualified revenue initially but suffered 12% lower 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable long-term revenue. Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and is supported by prior durable improvements in completion, time-to-value, adoption, and SMB activation. Run a standard experiment and evaluate qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation, since downstream revenue impact remains uncertain.
